definitions.explanation: excessive praise or compliments given to please someone, especially to gain favor

examples.japanese: {追従|ついしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追従|ついしょう}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{追従|ついしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嫌|きら}う→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: She's an honest person who dislikes flattery.

notes:
{追従|ついしょう} refers to excessive flattery, typically to curry favor.

PRONUNCIATION:
- ついしょう = flattery (this entry)
- ついじゅう = following, compliance (different word with same kanji)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追従|ついしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to flatter)
- {追従|ついしょう}⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧ (sycophantic laughter)
- {追従|ついしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to flatter - verb form)
- {追従|ついしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弄|ろう}する (to indulge in flattery - literary)

USAGE:
- Negative connotation: implies insincerity and self-interest
- Often used critically to describe someone trying to gain favor
- More formal/literary than ⟦おべっか→おべっか：07885_obekka⟧ or ごま⟦すり→すり：01330_suri⟧

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦おべっか→おべっか：07885_obekka⟧ (flattery - colloquial)
- ごま⟦すり→すり：01330_suri⟧ (brown-nosing - colloquial)
- ⟦お{世辞|せじ}→お世辞：07023_oseji⟧ (compliment - can be neutral)
- ⟦{阿諛|あゆ}→阿諛：09027_ayu⟧ (flattery - very formal/literary)
- へつらう (to flatter - verb)

REGISTER: Formal/literary. Used in formal writing and criticism.
